QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Peri Dotts, the Runaway Train
QuestInfo.0: You should return Peri's lost notes. You'll have to pretend like you didn't see the contents, but you won't forget about #bPeri#k's talents any time soon. She, too, has the potential to be a star.
QuestInfo.1:
Peri Dotts was embarrassed that the contents of her notes were seen, and she doesn't seem to be taking it too well. You need to calm #r#o4310016##k down first before she'll ever agree to an audition.

#r* If you fail to calm Peri Dotts, you must forfeit the quest and try again.
QuestInfo.2: If you want to be a star, you have to be able to fully express yourself, right? You managed to calm Peri down and remind her of her talents.

0.msg: #b(Despite her eccentricities, Peri seems extremely talented.)#k
#b(Peri blinks and looks around, having returned to her senses.)#k \nNow that you're, uh, feeling better, I wanted to ask you about auditioning to be Jackpot Entertainment's new singer.

1.msg: ...Me? Audition for your agency? Do you really think I have that kind of talent? I only wrote what was in my heart...

2.msg: (Sniffs) I don't think anyone's ever acknowledged my music before... No one's ever cared!

default.0: (After calming #r#o4310016##k down, you manage to have a normal conversation.)
